_comments: Switches the Animal form from the stacked accordion to MJ's left-nav sidebar.
This single value is the ONLY thing that flips the layout: ResolveFormLayout's 'auto' mode
needs 8 first-class groups before it switches on its own, and Animal has about three.
Puts Follow Up Date on the Care Logs grid. It is the column that tells you HOW overdue an
entry is, and the action-item grid on the Animal form is useless without it.
DefaultInView is what decides a grid's columns, so this is a metadata change rather than a
grid-level override -- and it improves the Care Log nav page for free.
